page.layout: One page of text, one column, no margin notes. Page number at the top left, running head at the top centre-right, catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: Epistola, tum in illa quam scribo ad
Te scriptam perinde atque ad illum
viarum sententiae nostrae, a qua visus
es hactenus plane alienus: dubium an
dae: an quia instillatum tibi est, prava
a quibus merito vir pius abhorreat.
fateor nostra non esse digna tuis oculis,
Teque excusatius errare, si non das
di, non solum a Pontificiis, sed & a
mi; sed ut lego in Tacito, quandoque
moveretur: Ego me Tibi sisto fiduciae
plenus futurum, ut Te Judice, si cau-
non peream: quin Te ad meas partes

page.notes: The printed text is set in roman type with long s; the line ending "addu-" is a catchword at the lower right, and the word continues on the next page. Ligature "st" read as "st". Some letters are worn at the left edge of the scan but all lines are legible.
